column1: # Phase 23 — shaping oracle. Values come from the Unicode standard
# (Arabic Presentation Forms-B), NOT from the indicator source:
# The validator looks the row up in the MQL5 tables by the base codepoint
# NOTE on the "final" column: a letter that cannot join to the left carries
# no final form. The indicator's joiner test is "fina != isol means this
# letter can connect to the left", so a non-joining letter must repeat its
# isolated form there (6..=isol) and pin initial/medial to 0. That is why
# hamza below repeats FE80 instead of "-"
# the preceding letter take a dangling initial form.
